title: One step of a transform pipeline
description: Today a step is a single-key mapping (`- filter: "LogL > -100"`); the density/interp/posterior steps additionally accept the discriminated `{type: <name>, ...}` form. `Figure/preprocessor_runtime.py::apply_transforms_impl` dispatches with an if/elif chain that has **no else branch**, so a misspelled step key is skipped in silence and the figure renders on untransformed data. Pinning the vocabulary here is what turns that into a diagnostic. G1/R2 replaces the whole shape with a discriminated union.

type.description: Discriminated form. Only the density / interp / posterior steps accept it today.

filter.description: Boolean expression over columns; rows evaluating false are dropped. A literal true/false (or 1/0) keeps or empties the table -- Figure/preprocessor_runtime.py::filter_df short-circuits on those.

to_csv.description: Write the table at this point of the pipeline (CSV). Debug aid, not a render step. Honoured at dataset load (data_loader_runtime) and in layer preprocess (preprocessor_runtime).

to_parquet.description: Write the table at this point of the pipeline (Parquet). Dataset-level only today (data_loader_runtime); same single-key form as to_csv.

profile.description: Profile-likelihood reduction over support cells. Keys are owned by Figure/profile_runtime.py.

make_density_core.description: Posterior mass over support cells. Keys are owned by Figure/density_cell_runtime.py.

posterior_density.description: Merged posterior-density pipeline. Keys are owned by Figure/posterior_density_runtime.py.

make_interp_2d.description: 2D interpolation onto a grid. Keys are owned by Figure/interp_2d_runtime.py.

x-jarvis-example:
transform:
  - filter: "LogL > -100"
  - add_column: {name: ratio, expr: "m_A / tanb"}
  - sortby: LogL

discriminatedStepName.description: Step names that also work in the `{type: ...}` form. Kept in sync with the _*_TYPES sets by tests/test_schema_catalog.py.
